stories.title: Russian missile attack on Kyiv kills one in overnight strike
stories.summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck the Ukrainian capital late Thursday, killing one person, damaging buildings and sparking a fire, officials said. The attack continues Russia's campaign against Kyiv amid the war.

stories.title: Bolsonaro ally blames ChatGPT for 'president-elect' claim
stories.summary: A close ally of Brazil's Flavio Bolsonaro said ChatGPT was responsible for language in a now-deleted letter in which the senator called himself the rightful 'president-elect' after losing Sunday's runoff. Bolsonaro still alleges the election was fraudulent.

stories.title: Waymo to test Toyota bZ4X robotaxis in Japan and the U.K.
stories.summary: Waymo will begin testing self-driving versions of Toyota's electric bZ4X in Japan next year, with plans to expand to the U.K. and other markets. The partnership combines Waymo's driverless technology with Toyota's vehicle manufacturing.

stories.title: Binance pauses withdrawals after suspected multi-billion-dollar hack
stories.summary: Binance suspended withdrawals after hackers drained billions in crypto from the world's largest exchange, with stablecoin issuers freezing over $1.8 billion in stolen tokens. It could rank among the largest crypto thefts in history.

stories.title: Mistral releases open weights for trillion-parameter Large 4 model
stories.summary: Mistral released open weights for Large 4, its trillion-parameter multimodal model aimed at software development and defensive cybersecurity. The release lets organizations run a frontier-scale model on their own infrastructure.

stories.title: Browns-Steelers preview: picks, Renegade practice and AFC North stakes
stories.summary: The 5-2 Browns visit the 5-2 Steelers on Sunday with sole possession of the AFC North lead at stake, with Pittsburgh a 3.5-point home favorite. Cleveland opened practice to 'Renegade' for a second straight day ahead of the matchup.

stories.title: Steelers' McCarthy unfazed by red-zone struggles before Browns game
stories.summary: Pittsburgh coach Mike McCarthy said he isn't panicking over the Steelers' 27th-ranked red-zone offense entering Sunday's game against the Browns. The winner of the 5-2 divisional matchup takes the outright AFC North lead.

stories.title: Column: Until they win in Pittsburgh, the Browns are still the Browns
stories.summary: A Pittsburgh columnist argues the Browns can't shed their reputation until they win in Pittsburgh, where Cleveland has long struggled. The 5-2 rivals meet Sunday with first place in the AFC North at stake.

stories.title: Ohio State lists 10 out, two questionable for USC game
stories.summary: Ten Buckeyes are out for Saturday's game at USC, including quarterback Julian Sayin and running back Ja'Kobi Jackson, with receiver Brandon Inniss and nickelback Jay Timmons questionable. Luke Fahey is expected to start at quarterback.

stories.title: Ohio State Thursday report: Timmons, Inniss questionable vs. USC
stories.summary: Ohio State's Thursday availability report listed Jay Timmons and Brandon Inniss questionable and cleared offensive lineman Austin Siereveld and defensive end Kenyatta Jackson Jr. to face USC. Ryan Day has yet to name a starting quarterback between Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov 1.3.0.0 patch brings back Halloween zombies
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov's 1.3.0.0 update launched its Halloween event, bringing zombies back to Tarkov, switching the in-game season to fall, and adding high-difficulty PMC bots to PvE zones.

stories.title: Japanese-inspired cafe opens in Bethel Center Mall
stories.summary: A new Japanese-inspired cafe has opened in Columbus's Bethel Center Mall, the latest addition to the shopping center's dining lineup.

stories.title: Lightning likely sparked Columbus house fire that killed three pets
stories.summary: A Columbus home was severely damaged in a fire likely caused by a lightning strike, leaving three pets dead, according to officials.

stories.title: Former Columbus teacher sentenced in student relationship case
stories.summary: A former Columbus teacher who had an inappropriate relationship with a student has been sentenced, according to court records.
